objective: Close Wave 3 A4: Brain B0-B3 retrieval must use a real token budget, preserve citations/gaps, and produce distinct context by level without exceeding budget.

criteria.promise: BeBrainContextProvider.retrieve(tokenBudget:) enforces a token budget for empty, light, and rich corpora; it never returns over-budget context.
B0/B1/B2/B3 levels remain distinct: no long-term evidence in B0/B1, bounded working context in B2, richer long-term context in B3.
Citations, source IDs, gaps, and truncation state survive budget cuts; tiny budgets fail closed rather than inventing evidence.

verification_gates.procedure: Inspect Retriever.swift and RetrievalTests.swift; run focused retrieval tests.
verification_gates.expected: Selection estimatedTokens never exceeds tokenBudget in tested corpora.

verification_gates.procedure: Run tests over B0-B3 with multiple hits.
verification_gates.expected: Different levels produce the expected scope/hit differences.

verification_gates.procedure: Run tests for citation/gap/truncation/tiny budget and git diff --check.
verification_gates.expected: Source metadata remains and over-budget/tiny-budget paths are explicit.

recon_evidence: Retriever.BeBrainContextProvider.retrieve(tokenBudget:), Retriever.context, MCPTools usage, and RetrievalTests were inspected. Existing code already budgets tokens; this ticket closes the edge-case and level-distinction proof.

first_checkpoint.evidence: Focused retrieval matrix for empty/light/rich corpora and B0-B3 levels.
